# pve_tasks (Data Source)

Lists recent tasks cluster wide as reported by `GET /cluster/tasks`. Running tasks have a null `endtime` and may not yet carry a `status`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Recent tasks cluster wide.

data "pve_tasks" "recent" {}

output "failed_tasks" {
  value = [for t in data.pve_tasks.recent.tasks : t.upid if t.status != "OK" && t.status != ""]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for the cluster task list.
- `tasks` (Attributes List) Recent cluster tasks, most recent first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))

<a id="nestedatt--tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks`

Read-Only:

- `endtime` (Number) End time as UNIX epoch seconds; 0 while the task is still running.
- `node` (String) Node the task runs on.
- `starttime` (Number) Start time as UNIX epoch seconds.
- `status` (String) Task status; `OK` on success, an error description on failure, empty while running.
- `type` (String) Task type (e.g. `vzdump`, `qmstart`).
- `upid` (String) Unique process identifier of the task.
- `user` (String) User who started the task.
